entry.title: Royal Spanish Academy

groundCutout.basis: Ground only beneath the closed building, rear projection, portico landing and integral west steps.

buildingCutout.basis: The source location resolves the institution Q11993457 to its Madrid headquarters Q26960988. Standard PMTiles places the named POI and its building under feature 35184457607397. The west-facing columned portico overlooks Ruiz de Alarcón. The solid rear wing on Calle Moreto occupies the eastward map projection. The north front preserves its balcony and secondary door. Only the matched main building footprint is replaced.

terrainReference.basis: Standard terrain sample just beyond the bottom of the west stairs. The front toe ties to the garden and the native slope is retained on all sides.

entry.note: Madrid headquarters exterior with a red-brick main block, pale stone courses, eleven-bay north front and balcony, a four-column Doric portico and granite stairs on the west side, and the projecting brick rear wing and tall windows on Calle Moreto. The low slate roof retains eight chimneys. Garden fences and surrounding streets remain part of the map context. The modeled main block measures about 28.4 by 44.2 m, with a 20 m cornice, 21.4 m roof and 23.4 m chimney caps. PMTiles records a coarse 8 m height. The model uses photo-based proportions. The original viewer terrain determines the west stair toe and rises toward the rear wing. The stair run has been fitted to the standard field and surveyed thresholds remain unknown. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
